title: Serving a website on a Raspberry Pi Zero running in RAM
summary: A technical guide on running a website on a Raspberry Pi Zero by storing files in RAM using tmpfs, reducing SD card wear and improving performance on this low-memory (512MB) single-board computer.
problem_solved: Optimizes website performance and extends SD card lifespan on resource-constrained devices like the Raspberry Pi Zero.
why_valuable: Running websites in RAM dramatically improves response times while preventing SD card degradation, making it ideal for low-power, always-on projects.
